# dm-csv-070

## Instruction
Calculate the number of individual wrestlers, tag teams, triple teams, and teams with more than 3 members from the Wrestlers table.

## About Dataset
The query retrieves the following information: 1. Count the number of wrestlers without any "&" symbol in their names, labeled as "No_of_Individual_Wrestlers".
2. Count the number of tag teams with one "&" symbol in their names, labeled as "No_of_Tag_Teams".
3. Count the number of triple teams with two "&" symbols in their names, labeled as "No_of_Triple_Teams".
4. Count the number of teams with more than three members, identified by having more than two "&" symbols in their names, labeled as "No_of_Teams_with_More_Than_3_Members". These counts are obtained from the "Wrestlers" table.
